# The simd package has no integer division, so '/' is not rewritten for any integer type.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func DivInt8s(dst, a, b []int8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivInt16s(dst, a, b []int16) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivInt64s(dst, a, b []int64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivUint8s(dst, a, b []uint8) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivUint16s(dst, a, b []uint16) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivUint32s(dst, a, b []uint32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}

func DivUint64s(dst, a, b []uint64) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] / b[i]
	}
}
